title: Microsoft Entra PowerShell Administration
scenario: NewVue Health administrators are preparing a management workstation to administer Microsoft Entra ID using PowerShell. The workstation must be configured with the correct modules and connected securely to the tenant.

activities.title: PowerShell Environment Preparation
activities.prompt: Arrange the steps required to prepare the workstation for Microsoft Entra PowerShell administration.

activities.title: Module Installation Command
activities.prompt: Complete the PowerShell command used to install the Microsoft Entra module.

activities.title: Execution Policy
activities.prompt: Which execution policy allows locally created scripts to run but requires downloaded scripts to be signed?
